children: , the AI cloud infrastructure provider, fell about 2.5% to $237.70 at roughly 10:39 a.m. ET Friday, despite a bullish call from BNP Paribas. The bank upgraded the stock to Outperform from Neutral and raised its price target to $399 from $260. That new target is nearly 68% above Friday's share price.

The optimism has numbers behind it. Nebius reported second-quarter revenue of $582.3 million, up 454% from a year earlier, and adjusted EBITDA of $236.2 million. Its investor presentation kept full-year annualized revenue run-rate guidance at $7 billion to $9 billion and described customer prepayments that can help fund new capacity.

The sharper question is how profitably Nebius can turn that capacity into revenue. Its GF Score of 55/100 shows strong momentum but a much weaker GF Value reading. That gap fits Friday's trading: investors can see the growth, yet construction costs, power availability and utilization still have to justify the price.

title: Nebius Stock Falls 2.5% While $399 Target Tests AI Expectations
